title: flt.c_peak~
description: `flt.c_peak~` calculates biquad coefficients for a peaking equalizer from center frequency, gain, and Q, and is intended to drive a filter such as `flt.biquad~`. It accepts a control signal and outputs the five coefficients b0, b1, b2, a1, and a2; frequency, gain, and Q can also be set with `@freq`, `@gain`, and `@q`.
